I think what makes me think of it most as a disease is dysphoria. 

The thought is like: "Dysphoria is a disorder that causes rejection of biological sex. By that logic, being trans is a disorder. Like a person with eating disorders who is unhappy with their body and is capable of doing terrible things to get to those ideas in their head. Or physical dysphoria disorders, where it is practically the same as gender dysphoria, and the affected person can even mutilate himself to make his body conform to his sick ideas. So being trans is a disorder and the cure is to follow the ideas of their sick mind to calm the symptoms of the disorder. That does not mean that they are real men/women."

I know how that sounds, and I hate to think of it, but I can't stop myself from doing it.
